topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can hardly believe what I saw today. It was my piece, one of my favorites, the one where I poured my heart out during those long, silent nights. Now, it’s etched permanently on someone’s skin. I know, logically, that it’s a form of flattery, a sign that my work touched someone deeply enough to want to carry it with them always. But the thought of it being changed, interpreted through someone else's understanding, almost feels like a part of me is being carried away, altered. I wonder if they know the layers of meaning, the struggle and the peace that went into every brushstroke. It’s a strange mix of honored and...well, I just wish they had asked.
